name: Maksupay Gateway for WooCommerce
author: maksupay

sections.description:
Maksupay Gateway for WooCommerce adds Maksupay as a payment option on your WooCommerce store. Customers can pay securely using their preferred payment methods processed through Maksupay.

Features:
– Accept payments via Maksupay payment processor
– Support for EUR and USD currencies
– Test mode for sandbox testing
– Refund processing from WooCommerce admin
– WooCommerce Blocks checkout support
– Debug mode for troubleshooting
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gateway-maksupay folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the “Maksupay Gateway for WooCommerce” plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  4. Click on “Maksupay” to configure the payment gateway
  5. Enter your Maksupay merchant credentials:
    • Merchant ID
    • Private Key
    • Redirect URL (provided by Maksupay)
    • Optional: Merchant Certificate, Processor Certificate
  6. Configure available currencies (default: EUR, USD)
  7. Enable the gateway and save changes
sections.faq:
Do I need a Maksupay account?

Yes, you need to register for a Maksupay merchant account at https://maksupay.com/ to receive payments.

Which currencies are supported?

The plugin supports EUR and USD by default. You can configure additional currencies in the plugin settings.

Does this plugin support refunds?

Yes, you can process refunds directly from the WooCommerce order admin panel.

Is there a test mode?

Yes, you can enable test mode in the plugin settings to test payments without processing real transactions.

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes, the plugin includes full support for WooCommerce Blocks checkout.

Where can I find my Maksupay credentials?

Log in to your Maksupay merchant dashboard at https://maksupay.com/ to access your credentials.
